answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a plume as the anchor of the cost.
